description: This file defines a Widget for an iOS app using SwiftUI and ActivityKit. It creates a live activity widget called OpenClawLiveActivity, which displays different views and statuses, such as connection state, timer, and activity labels, including handling of dynamic island regions.

methods.name: lockScreenView
methods.description: Creates the lock screen view showing activity status and a dot indicator, organizing content with HStack and VStack.

methods.name: trailingView
methods.description: Displays a view indicating connection status or elapsed time based on the content state.

methods.name: statusDot
methods.description: Returns a small colored circle representing activity status.

methods.name: dotColor
methods.description: Determines the color of the status dot based on connection and activity state.
